messages:
maya: Quick watercooler poll - if our models were coworkers, who is the desk-buddy that brings snacks and bad puns? Vote with emoji or drop a one-liner. Options:
```
:dog: gpt-bouncy - overly friendly, gives unsolicited tips
:owl: llama-sage - quietly corrects your docs at 2am
:koala: redwood-tiny - naps in a corner, dependable router of requests
:banana: hallucination-bot - always eating the label off the jar
```Anyone? :popcorn:

jon: :dog: for gpt-bouncy. He would bring bagels and then try to optimize your calendar. :bagel:

aisha: :owl: llama-sage. 100% the one who leaves sticky notes with citations. :books:

sam: :koala: redwood-tiny - quietly purring in the infra rack. also :banana: for hallucination-bot because it keeps stealing my lunch predictions. :shrug:

ben: lol this thread made me do a thing -> https://giphy.com/gifs/dog-office-1K4Zm5i9m3a0 (office dog energy) :joy:

claire: voted :dog: but also submitting a formal request to adopt the desk-buddy as a team mascot. @maya can we make a sticker? :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:

devops-bot: Reminder: infra maintenance window tomorrow 11:30-12:00 UTC. Will not interrupt snack polls. :gear:

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled at 12:15 UTC - tagging in case mascot energy is correlated with latency. :rocket:

maya: tally so far (manual, scientific):
```
:dog: 2
:owl: 1
:koala: 1
:banana: 1
```Keep votes coming. Bonus points for a model-slogan. Example: gpt-bouncy - "Will reheat your coffee and your code." :coffee: :laughing:

jon: slogan contest entry: llama-sage - "Always cites, rarely argues." :clap:

aisha: redwood-tiny slogan: "Small footprint, giant nap." :zzz:

sam: also proposing we name the next on-call rotation after the winner. low-stakes but high vibes. :wave:

claire: agreed. if hallucination-bot wins we get a mystery-flavored snack box every month. maybe not a bad experiment. :banana: :thinking_face:

maya: ok closing informal poll in 20m and sending results to #all-hands for sticker considerations. thanks for the chaos. :sparkles:
